# Dallas Clinicals

> Dallas Clinicals is a clinical research center with two DFW facilities —
> Plano (Collin County) and Greenville (Hunt County) — running Phase I-IV
> trials under Principal Investigator Hassan Farooq, MD. It recruits patient
> volunteers and partners with pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs.

Key facts:
- Locations: Plano, TX (Collin County) and Greenville, TX (Hunt County).
- Principal Investigator: Hassan Farooq, MD.
- Director of Research: Shams Islam.
- Therapeutic areas: Dermatology, Endocrinology, Metabolism (GLP-1/Obesity),
  Respiratory, Infectious Diseases.
- Phone: 214-714-3597. Email: info@dallasclinicals.com.
- FDA-compliant, GCP-adherent, IRB-overseen trials.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dallasclinicals.com/): Overview of the Plano/Greenville
  dual-site model and PI credentials.
- [For Sponsors](https://dallasclinicals.com/sponsors.php): Recruitment
  advantages for pharmaceutical sponsors and CROs, protocol inquiry form.
- [For Patients](https://dallasclinicals.com/patients.php): What clinical
  trial phases (I-IV) mean, patient safety and IRB oversight.
- [Locations](https://dallasclinicals.com/locations.php): Plano and
  Greenville facility addresses, hours, and contact details.
- [About](https://dallasclinicals.com/about.php): Mission, leadership
  (Hassan Farooq, MD; Shams Islam).
- [Check Eligibility](https://dallasclinicals.com/check-eligibility.php):
  Patient intake form that routes inquiries to the nearest facility.
